Kaukuṭṭaka : m. (pl.): Name of a Janapada.

Listed by Saṁjaya among the southern Janapadas (also called Deśas 6. 10. 68) of the Bhāratavarṣa (athāpare janapadā dakṣiṇā…kaukuṭṭakās tathā colāḥ) 6. 10. 56, 58.

; āvarjitāḥ dāsavad vaśagāḥ); the Kṣatriyas among them brought wealth in hundreds for Yudhiṣṭhira's Rājasūya (kaukurās… āhārṣuḥ kṣatriyā vittaṁ śataśo 'jātaśatrave) 2. 48. 14-16.
